title: 第5章 引气入体第6章 成为弟子
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
片刻之后，极阴失望的收回目光。
“已经三天了，还没有一人成功感知灵气存在。”
宋文见所有人都不做反应，他也没有主动暴露自己感知到灵气存在。
“看来自己的修行天赋还不错，至少比眼前这百余人都强！”
宋文在心中暗暗的想道。
是日夜晚，宋文成功将第一缕天地灵气引入了体内。
他感知空中的亮点涌入了身体之中，霎时，一股微弱的暖流凭空出现在经脉之中，按照《长生功》的功法路线在体内流转。
宋文双目一亮，正准备再接再厉之时，他脑海之中又冒出一个不好的念头。
“万一极阴能感知到他人的修为，若让他知晓我已成功引气入体，还故意隐瞒，恐怕会对我不利。”
考虑到此处，宋文顿时停止了修炼。
他刚一停止修炼，四周原本受到牵引、正向他涌来的天地灵气顿时失去了目标，开始再度无序的在空中飘浮。
而刚刚进入他体内的那一缕天地灵气，由于并没有来得及被炼化，并没有真正化为宋文自身的灵力，在失去《长生功》的牵引之后，也缓慢的逸散到空气中。
“好险，看来接下来几日要暂停修炼了，只需要在外人面前做做样子就好。”
打定主意的宋文倒头就睡。
时间转眼就过去四日，来到修炼的七天。
这日清晨。
宋文刚走出房门，便听到有人在高声议论。
一名皮肤黝黑，身材瘦弱而精壮，带着几分木讷的男子，被一众年轻人眼带羡慕的围着。
“二牛，你真的引气入体了？”
“二牛哥，快指导我们一下，给我们传授一下引气入体的经验！”

二牛黝黑的脸庞浮出一抹红晕，出生农村，不善交流的他还是第一次体会到众星捧月的感觉，让他兴奋自豪的同时，又有些手足无措。
涨红着脸，一时不知该如何应对。
“你们干什么呢！”
一个粗暴严厉的声音突然打断了众人的议论。
极阴迈步走到厢房区域，脸上带着怒气。
“大清早，不知好好修炼，为何大声喧哗？”
面对极阴的怒斥，众人瞬间鸦雀无声，纷纷畏惧的低下脑袋。
由于二牛站在众人的最中心，极阴的目光很自然的落在了二牛身上。
二牛顿时有些战战兢兢，极阴严厉的目光让他感觉异常难受，像极了他在老家打猎时，被豺狼虎豹盯上的感觉。
二牛一动不敢动，只敢低声的解释道。
“禀报大人，我昨晚成功引气入体了，所以...”
content_en:
After a moment, Jiyin looked away in disappointment.
"It's been three days, and no one has successfully sensed the existence of spiritual energy."
Song Wen saw that no one reacted, and he did not take the initiative to reveal that he sensed the existence of spiritual energy.
"It seems that my cultivation talent is pretty good, at least better than the hundreds of people in front of me!"
Song Wen thought secretly in his heart.
That night, Song Wen successfully introduced the first ray of heaven and earth spiritual energy into his body.
He felt the bright spots in the air pouring into his body. Suddenly, a weak warm current appeared in his meridians out of thin air, flowing through his body according to the route of the "Longevity Kung Fu".
Song Wen's eyes lit up, and just as he was about to continue his efforts, another bad thought came to his mind.
"In case Ji Yin can sense the cultivation of others, if he knows that I have successfully introduced Qi into my body and deliberately conceals it, I am afraid it will be detrimental to me."
Thinking of this, Song Wen immediately stopped practicing.
As soon as he stopped practicing, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth that had been drawn around him and was rushing towards him suddenly lost its target and began to float in the air disorderly again.
The ray of heaven and earth spiritual energy that had just entered his body did not have time to be refined and did not really turn into Song Wen's own spiritual power. After losing the traction of "Immortality Skill", it slowly dissipated into the air.
"It's so dangerous. It seems that I will suspend my practice in the next few days. I just need to show off in front of outsiders."
Song Wen made up his mind and fell asleep.
Four days passed in the blink of an eye, and it was the seventh day of practice.
This morning.
As soon as Song Wen walked out of the door, he heard someone talking loudly.
A man with dark skin, thin but muscular body, and a bit of dullness was surrounded by a group of young people with envious eyes.
"Er Niu, did you really introduce Qi into your body?"
"Brother Erniu, please guide us quickly and teach us the experience of introducing Qi into the body!"
A blush appeared on Er Niu's dark face. He was born in a rural area and was not good at communicating. This was the first time he experienced the feeling of being surrounded by stars. It made him excited and proud, but at the same time a little at a loss.
My face turned red and I didn't know how to respond.
"What are you doing!"
A rough and stern voice suddenly interrupted everyone's discussion.
Ji Yin walked to the wing area with anger on his face.
"It's early in the morning and I don't know how to practice properly, so why are I making so much noise?"
Faced with Ji Yin's angry rebuke, everyone fell silent for an instant, lowering their heads in fear.
Since Er Niu stood at the center of the crowd, his extremely gloomy eyes naturally fell on Er Niu.
He was a little trembling when he was two Newtons, and the extremely stern eyes made him feel extremely uncomfortable, just like the feeling he felt when he was being stared at by jackals, tigers and leopards when he was hunting in his hometown.
Er Niu didn't dare to move, so he only dared to explain in a low voice.
"Sir, I successfully introduced Qi into my body last night, so..."
